_howto: One file per city, named <slug>.json, matching data/cities.json.
Populate by hand from the published Michelin Guide for that city.
Michelin has no API and prohibits scraping the guide; curate manually.
Coordinates only need to be within ~150m — they are for matching, not display.
Re-check each city when the guide for that country is announced (annually).
Valid awards: three_stars, two_stars, one_star, bib_gourmand, green_star.
A venue may hold several, e.g. ["two_stars", "green_star"].
